---
title: "The architecture"
subtitle: "How the platform is put together"
---

This section describes the platform as a whole. Chapters are listed in the
sidebar and are numbered in order. The complete document is also rendered as
one [PDF](complete.pdf) and one [Word document](complete.docx) for people who
would rather read it offline.

## How this section is maintained

Hand-written chapters are plain Markdown files named `NN-slug.md`. Generated
chapters are `.qmd` files with Python cells that read the environment
descriptions in `data/` and write Markdown; see the
[environments chapter](02-environments.qmd) for the pattern. Add a new chapter
by creating the file with the next number — the sidebar and the combined
document pick it up (the combined document lists chapters explicitly in
`complete.qmd`, so add it there too).
